questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question_en: What is the approximate angular momentum (in J s) of electron in hydrogen atom in its ground state? (h = 6.625×10⁻³⁴ J s)
questions.note: Option 3's text is ABSENT FROM THE OFFICIAL SOURCE PDF, not from our crop. Confirmed three independent ways on page 91 of the source: (a) the rendered crop shows the label and green tick with nothing beside them; (b) the PDF text layer holds the four option LABELS as text spans (option 3's is green, 008000) but no value text; (c) the option VALUES are raster images, and the page carries value images at option 1, 2 and 4's rows only - at option 3's row there is nothing but the 16x16 tick icon. The answer is not in doubt: the key and the vision pass both read option 3, and L = h/2π = 1.055×10⁻³⁴ J s = 1055×10⁻³⁷, which is exactly the value the three printed distractors are built around (2110×10⁻³⁷ is 2× it, 1055×10⁻³⁶ is 10× it). That value is NOT written into options_en, because deriving a string is not transcribing one. The question is held out of the bank; promoting it means a human deciding to print a reconstructed option.
